parameters.bandwidthPolicy: fixed at the bandwidth selected on the observed data

formulas.ascii: s_k = population standard deviation of the local estimates beta_ik over the tracts with a finite fit. Permutation p relabels (X, y) among the tracts with a keyed swap-or-not shuffle, refits every tract at the bandwidth already selected on the observed data, and records s_k^(p). g_k = number of permutations with s_k^(p) >= s_k; pseudo p = (g_k + 1)/(P + 1); z_k = (s_k - mean of s_k^(p))/sd of s_k^(p). Failed permuted fits are left out and counted.
